cause: The generated program calls (orders/place {:subtotal 100}) expecting total=120 (subtotal 100 + standard charge 20), but pricing.rule/apply-standard adds only 2 instead of 20, producing total=102, which fails the equality check and triggers the explicit failure with kind order-total-mismatch.
evidence: The generated program source: (let [quote (orders/place {"subtotal" 100})] (if (= (get quote "total") 120) quote (fail {:kind "order-total-mismatch"})))
orders/place calls pricing.tax/add-standard which calls pricing.rule/apply-standard on the subtotal
pricing.rule/apply-standard source: (defn apply-standard [subtotal] (+ subtotal 2)) — adds 2, not the documented 20
